facts: Separate government functions in the two wing blocks
Central dome with 29 windows and columns
Porte-cochère arrangements of five and nine columns
Bruneian decorative motifs on columns and walls
The current Legislative Council Building was inaugurated on 4 March 2008 and hosts council sittings.
The owner identifies the central chamber and traditional Bruneian decorative motifs used both inside and on the exterior.

notes: Reviewed the original Qualla media first. Its old group portrait does not depict this building. No external image was selected. The model is supported by the contemporary government building description, official opening date, named roof outline and covered entrance trace.
